messages:
nina_sales: Heads-up 10: AcmeLabs POC. They want: signed MSA/DPA, SOC2 attestation, DocuSign with exec + procurement countersign, and a temporary reserved commit for 45 days. Also asked if we can accept their redlines on data residency. cc @oliver_legal @ryan_se
ryan_se: On the tech side: recommended footprint is 256 token seq, 120 qps peak. Suggest Dedicated micro-pool for consistent latency. We can run on hosted but latency jitter may interfere with eval.
jen_ops: Dedicated micro-pool lead time ~72h, subject to GPU availability. For temporary reserved commit we can do pro-rated billing but finance needs min commit threshold. What's the unit they want to reserve (tokens/day or instance-hours)?
marc_sales: Customer wants token/day commit. Finance told me earlier they can approve a 30-60 day pro-rated tranche if commit >= 2M tokens/day at 40% off list. I'll confirm.
oliver_legal: Please upload their MSA redline. Quick notes: we typically don't accept data residency modifications that change our subprocessors without a DPA addendum. We have a standard DPA + cross-border schedule; if they require tenant-only storage in EU, that triggers Private deploy options. Also HSM/KMS requests need the HSM addendum + security sign-off.
nina_sales: They prefer net30 payment and request an invoice remit to their EU entity. Also asking for additional liability cap for POC; can legal advise?
oliver_legal: Liability cap: for POCs we can keep standard cap (2x fees or $250k) but can consider lowering if they commit to reserved commit and enterprise contract. I'll draft language.
ryan_se: KMS question: they want customer-managed keys (CMK). We support CMK in Private and Dedicated with HSM addendum. If they require CMK for hosted, it's not supported today. Flagging to ops.
jen_ops: Noted. If they accept Dedicated we can enable CMK and scoped keys; add 5 business days for KMS entitlements and attestation.
marc_sales: How about signature flow? DocuSign ok? They want exec signs first then procurement countersigns. Also prefer embedded signing for procurement.
oliver_legal: DocuSign OK. We need explicit signer order and emails. For embedded signing we require technical contact and app integration review. Simpler to do standard DocuSign envelope.
billing-bot: :calendar: Invoice template created for AcmeLabs, payment terms field: NET30. Draft invoice id: INV-ACM-00021 (draft).
marc_sales: I'll collect signers and send the order form + pricing sheet. Action items: 1) @oliver_legal prepare MSA reply + DPA notes 2) @jen_ops estimate Dedicated lead time and KMS timeline 3) @ryan_se prepare runbook + perf notes 4) @marc_sales confirm pricing min commit.
nina_sales: Thanks. If legal and ops approve the addenda, we aim to send DocuSign by EOD Thursday. Please flag blockers here.
